children: Philip Morris increased its regular quarterly dividend to $1.60 per share, an 8.8% rise to an annualized $6.40.
Board declared quarterly dividend of $1.60, up from $1.47, representing an 8.8% increase.
New dividend payable Oct 26, 2026, to shareholders of record as of Oct 2, 2026; ex-dividend date Oct 2.
Annual dividend has increased every year since 2008, total rise of 248% (CAGR 7.2%).
Smoke-free products accounted for ~42% of Q2 2026 net revenues, supporting dividend capacity.
